requirement:
HC's FIXME review uses an agent criterion to assess whether each linked issue's
title and opening post describe the FIXME's acknowledged gap. It selects the
FIXME's tracking-issue edges through the SDK's tracked interface and supplies
the FIXME and selected issue contents through tracked reads or ask insertions.

A completed assessment that an issue is unrelated fails that issue's relevance
check.
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.related` has no `{test}` references or `:test:` anchors. The `references` tool returned no sites at all, and a text search for relevance and unrelated-answer tests found none.

Obligations that need tests:
- Selecting the FIXME's tracking-issue edges through the SDK's tracked interface.
- Supplying the FIXME and the selected issue contents through tracked reads or ask insertions.
- Failing an issue's relevance check when a completed assessment says the issue is unrelated.

None of these has a test, so the gap is real.

The gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a `{fixme}` on this requirement. It names `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26`, which is open. Its body says the agent-based relevance criterion is deferred. It also says the tests do not yet check tracking-edge selection, delivered FIXME/issue snapshots, or unrelated answers. That matches the missing-test gap described above. A search for other relevant tests found only unrelated ones, such as `test_edges_select_only_tests_for_the_requested_requirement`, which concerns test edges rather than issue relevance. Nothing contradicts the acknowledgment.
